title: SugarCraft — SugarFuzzy
description: SugarFuzzy: Fuzzy string matching with matched character indices plus the match score — Smith-Waterman + Sahilm algorithms. Extracted from sugar-forms; enables filter-highlighting UIs across the ecosystem.
ogDescription: Fuzzy string matcher that returns matched character indices plus the match score. Two algorithms: Smith-Waterman (local alignment) and Sahilm (gum-style). Enables filter-highlighting UIs impossible with score-only matchers.
tagline: Fuzzy string matching with matched character indices plus the match score
